newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline edges up with firmer NYMEX unleaded.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline edges up with firmer NYMEX unleaded.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices edged slightly higher on Friday in line with crude gains and as NYMEX unleaded futures firmed around one cent a gallon.
"Prices have steadied a little with the NYMEX but the cargo market over here is still fairly well supplied and there's little buying around," one trader said.
Prompt Eurograde barges were offered at $191, around $1 up from Thursday but $3 down on the week. Buying interest remained around $188 fob ARA. Cargoes were steady at $196/198 cif NWE.
Gasoline was seen edging higher next week but traders said much will depend on the U.S. with European buying limited.
"The market will stay on hold for a while until people see how U.S. May demand pans," a trader said.

Gasoline demand is supposed to increase in the spring and summer and provide a bullish underpinning to the market, but last week's bearish U.S. inventory data, particularly for gasoline, continued to haunt traders.
However, the hefty inventory builds were being offset on Friday by a change in sentiment and forecasts that gasoline will rally soon on seasonal driving demand.
U.S. traders said poor weather in some U.S. regions had created a slow start to spring when there is a seasonal uptick in gasoline demand leading up to the summer driving season.
